aviation_incidents.headline: 調查人員在佛羅里達墜機現場數英里外發現Learjet升降舵殘骸
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）委員查普曼在11月3日的簡報中表示，調查人員在佛羅里達州棕櫚灘郡墜機地點外1.3至3.8英里處，尋獲Learjet60左升降舵的三塊殘骸，合計約為左升降舵的大部分，證實機尾部件在撞擊地面前已於空中分離。該機11月1日墜毀於格林埃克斯附近的南軍事步道一帶，機上2名機組員與7名乘客全數罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Investigators find pieces of Learjet's elevator miles from Florida crash site
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Investigators have recovered three pieces of a Learjet 60's left elevator between 1.3 and 3.8 miles from the road where the jet crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, on November 1, 2026, killing both pilots and all seven passengers. The pieces account for most of the left elevator, and National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) member Tom Chapman said at a November 3 briefing that their discovery confirms part of the tail separated in flight.

international_aviation.headline: AutoFlight完成5架無人eVTOL編隊飛行，據稱全球首次
international_aviation.summary: 中國AutoFlight完成據稱全球首次由5架無人eVTOL組成的編隊飛行，並於2026年11月5日公布飛行影片。編隊由1架5噸級V5000與4架2噸級V2000CG組成，均由AutoFlight自行設計製造；公司稱這次飛行是多機協同與無人物流的重要里程碑。
international_aviation.headline_en: AutoFlight flies five unmanned eVTOLs in formation in claimed world first
international_aviation.summary_en: China's AutoFlight has staged what is claimed to be the world's first formation flight involving five unmanned eVTOL aircraft, sharing a video of the flight on November 5, 2026. The formation comprised a single five-ton V5000 and four two-ton V2000CG aircraft, all designed and built by AutoFlight. The company described the flight as a milestone in multi-aircraft coordination and unmanned logistics.

international_aviation.headline: 美司法部要求法院准許沒收中國註冊灣流G550，涉未經許可飛往伊朗
international_aviation.summary: 美國司法部已請求加州聯邦法官，准許政府保有聯邦幹員2026年5月在阿拉斯加安克拉治扣押的一架中國註冊灣流G550公務機。檢方表示，這架美國製造的公務機在未取得必要美國許可的情況下，自北京飛往德黑蘭，並在伊朗停留6天。
international_aviation.headline_en: US seeks to keep Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 seized after trip to Iran
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Justice Department has asked a federal judge in California to let the government keep a Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 that federal agents seized in Alaska in May 2026. Prosecutors say the US-built business jet flew from Beijing to Tehran without the required US authorization and spent six days in Iran.

international_aviation.headline: 波音Everett新產線投產737MAX10，Renton廠不再受限於機身長度
international_aviation.summary: 波音10月26日在Everett新設的北產線（North Line）推出首架737MAX10，該機將交付啟動客戶西捷航空（WestJet）；這是自1970年以來，首款不在波音歷史悠久的Renton廠組裝的737機型。737MAX10機身長143呎8吋（43.8公尺），Renton廠房空間狹小，若在當地生產，必須將加長的機身錯置在MAX8等較短機型之間，以免與相鄰工位結構重疊；Everett廠房空間較大，可讓MAX10連續以機頭接機尾的方式移動，不需錯位緩衝。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing's Renton Factory Must Stagger The 737 MAX 10 With Smaller Jets, But Everett Can Run Nose-To-Tail
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing rolled the first 737 MAX 10 out of its new North Line at the Everett facility on October 26, and the aircraft is destined for launch customer WestJet. It is the first time a 737 variant has been assembled outside Boeing's historic Renton plant since 1970. The 737 MAX 10's fuselage measures 143 feet, 8 inches (43.8 meters), and Renton's compact assembly bays forced Boeing to stagger the elongated airframe between smaller variants like the MAX 8 to prevent structural overlap between adjacent stations. By repurposing space in Everett's massive widebody plant, Boeing has given its largest narrowbody an assembly line tailored to its length.
